entries.message: Alternate-order history review and repair, a much smaller Docker image, and a round of sync and frontend hardening.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Tweak: Alternate-order history review and repair, a much smaller Docker image, and a round of sync and frontend hardening.
Tweak: Manual episode actions use the selected TVDB order when saving new watches.
Tweak: Earlier watches with uncertain episode identity appear in Manual Watch review with aired and selected-order candidates.
Tweak: An administrator confirms the intended episode before Plekt repairs history after verifying a local backup.
Tweak: Force Sync of an already-synced title no longer removes a Trakt play without adding it back.
Tweak: Added users no longer share a show identity cache, Seerr status cache, scheduler guard, dispatch sweep flag or live-change prune timer.
Tweak: Unwatches and duplicate watches need stronger evidence, so a partly watched Plex item or an Emby-only watch is no longer changed on thin evidence.

Tweak: A partial or failed provider read for Plex watchlists, playlists, resume feeds or Jellyfin watched scans is no longer treated as a complete one; resume scans continue across full pages when Plex omits the total count.
Tweak: A throwing lease renewal or scheduled job still schedules the next run, and a stalled response body now stops at the configured timeout.
Tweak: Old session cookies stop working for a re-created user, an administrator password reset signs the user out, and repeated slashes no longer skip rate limits.
Tweak: The cloud metadata block also catches trailing dots, IPv4-mapped and NAT64 IPv6 forms and more metadata addresses.
Tweak: Testing a Plex notification or Tautulli connection with a different URL now needs its own token or key instead of reusing the saved one.
Tweak: Keep watched episodes on their selected DVD or alternate-order cards when dashboard history refreshes, and clear obsolete review markers after a verified mapping.
Tweak: Rebuild show progress after history restores and data wipes so restored and removed shows have current counts without a restart.
Tweak: Include older watches beyond the newest 25,000 rows when filtering and deduplicating history.
Tweak: Apply watch-date and record deletions atomically with their related playstate changes.
Tweak: Retain cached cast, videos, artwork and next-airing dates during temporary metadata outages, and retry incomplete show records after five minutes.
Tweak: Retry failed TVDB artwork discovery and poster downloads without leaving requests stuck or recording failures for redacted source URLs.
Tweak: Use the server's local calendar day for release-date filters, next-airing dates and playlist rules, including full provider timestamps for today.
Tweak: Explain that full backup restores preserve the destination machine's media and tracker connections and require reconnecting missing services.
Tweak: Keep newly approved DVD and alternate-order watches visible when an older dashboard snapshot still marks the episode unwatched, while respecting genuinely newer unwatches.
Tweak: Refresh derived watch-state caches after successful review decisions so reopening a show reflects the saved decision immediately.
Tweak: Preserve verified episode identities when played-flag webhooks apply the watch-date policy, allowing queued reviews to approve and target the correct episode.
Tweak: The Docker image is about half the size: it no longer includes the demo artwork or the unused npm cache and other-platform native builds.
Tweak: The container healthcheck no longer fails in demo mode, where there is no scheduler to find.
Tweak: The notice on the retiring Docker image no longer covers the sidebar logo on windows about 761 to 900 px wide, and it now sits below the top bar on phones instead of hiding its heading.
Tweak: An install running the retiring Docker image now also prints a one-line notice in its startup log pointing to the Plekt image.
Tweak: Keep confirmations safe to cancel and settle replaced dialogs
Tweak: Keep the app usable when browser storage is blocked or full
Tweak: Preserve newer dashboard options and Up Next watch prompts during slow or failed requests
Tweak: Retry transient search failures instead of retaining them for the session

entries.message: Fix - Translate alternate-order imports before saving watch history
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Fix: Import Watched Status verifies every episode before saving and keeps episodes distinct when media servers use different orders.
Fix: Manual Watch Review matches episode names to stored numbering and labels verified alternate-order watches with aired episode numbers.
Fix: Review season metadata stays separate from DVD display metadata in the browser cache.

majorBugFixes: Import Watched Status verifies every episode before saving and keeps episodes distinct when media servers use different orders.
Manual Watch Review matches episode names to stored numbering and labels verified alternate-order watches with aired episode numbers.
Review season metadata stays separate from DVD display metadata in the browser cache.

majorBugFixes.title: Sync & provider recovery

entries.message: This update improves episode ordering, resume synchronization, and dashboard Up Next settings.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Episode thumbnails load correctly after changing a show to DVD or another TVDB order.
Watches saved before choosing an episode order stay out of episode cards and watched counts, with one notice per season; existing watch records remain unchanged.
Watch actions and manual review preserve verified episode identity when mappings change, while Up Next displays the selected TVDB order.
Clearing a resume position on Plex, Emby or Jellyfin clears it on the other servers, including when Plex misses the notification for a resume-only clear.
Plex missed-notification checks reconcile a watched-then-unwatched item and dismiss any superseded review.
The dashboard Up Next cog controls media-app queue syncing with the same saved setting as Settings.
The dashboard options popup stays within the screen, scrolls when needed, and explains each option briefly.

tweaks.title: Up Next & watch-state
details: This update includes show episode thumbnails and hide unplaced watches after changing a show's episode order, preserve episode identity and clear cross-server resume state, reconcile Plex resume-only clears after missed notifications, and improve dashboard Up Next quick settings.
Up Next shows the selected TVDB order while storage and tracker writes remain in aired order.

tweaks.title: Manual Watch review
details: Manual Watch Review keeps verified episode identity through approval when mappings change.

tweaks.title: Sync & connection recovery
details: Episode thumbnails now load after switching a show to DVD or another TVDB order, instead of showing a broken or blank image.

Watches saved before an episode order was chosen no longer appear as extra "Unmatched" episode cards or inflate the watched count. Each season shows one notice with how many are hidden, and nothing is changed or removed.
Episode thumbnails now load after switching a show to DVD or another TVDB order.
Watches saved before an order was selected stay out of episode cards and watched counts, with one notice per season and no changes to existing records.
Clearing a resume position on Plex, Emby or Jellyfin clears the other servers too, even when Plekt already considers the item unwatched.
Plex recovers a watched-then-unwatched item when its notification is missed and dismisses the superseded review.
Playback and watch actions resolve through exact episode identities.
Clearing a part watched item on Plex also removes the other servers' resume positions when no watch history or pending review exists, even if its notification is missed.
Control media-app queue syncing from the dashboard cog with the same saved setting as Settings.
Keep the options popup clear of dashboard clipping and within the screen, with scrolling when space is limited.
Explain each option with a short summary instead of a long block of playback guidance.
